text:
emma: Heads-up: We're coordinating the public launch announcement for Redwood Inference next week. Need final blog intro, 1-sentence CEO quote, two social variants, and confirm embargo timing. Can folks drop what they have here by EOD?

jasper: Media plan in progress. Target outlets: TechCrunch, Wired, The Verge, Platformer. Plan to embargo 24 hours until 09:00 PT on launch day. Is that ok?

emma: 24h embargo sounds right. jasper, can you also confirm who on the PR team will handle reporter outreach?

jasper: I'll own outreach. Will send embargo notices once copy is final. Need a short tech blurb from product to include in the email.

lucy: Product blurb: "Redwood Inference unifies hosted, dedicated, and private inference with consistent APIs, observability, and cost controls for production teams." Keeping it tight.

tom: From eng: please avoid raw perf claims in the headline. We can provide benchmark artifacts in the PR kit and an appendix for press.

emma: Noted — we'll put perf caveat: "see benchmarks in press kit". Also need CEO quote for the press release (1 line) and a 2-line version for the blog.

lucy: Suggest CEO 1-line: "We built Redwood Inference to make reliable, cost-effective LLM serving available to every engineering team."

jasper: Good. Can we also get a punchy 140-character social variant and a longer LinkedIn post?

emma: Drafts: 
1) Tweet (short): "Introducing Redwood Inference: predictable, high-performance LLM serving — now available. Learn more: <link> #mlinfra"
2) LinkedIn (longer): "Today we’re launching Redwood Inference, a platform that helps engineering teams deploy LLM features with predictable latency, cost controls, and enterprise-ready options including dedicated and private deployments. Read the launch blog and benchmarks: <link>"

legal: Quick legal check: remove any absolutes like "industry-leading" or "fastest". Also replace any assertion of compliance with "supports integrations with common KMS providers" unless you have an explicit attestation. Send me the blog draft once the security blurb is included.

lucy: Security blurb to include: "Supports customer-managed KMS integrations and audit logs for enterprise deployments."

emma: Great. jasper, for embargo emails, please include a link to the press kit and the benchmarks appendix. Tom, can you export the benchmark graphs and include a short readme for journalists?

 tom: Will export graphs + a small README describing environment & test harness. Expect assets by 4pm PT.

deploy-bot: Created calendar event "Launch coordination call" for 2025-04-10 16:00 PT. Invitees: emma, jasper, lucy, tom, legal.

emma: Final checklist: blog draft, CEO quotes (1-line + 2-line), tweet + LI copy, press kit (benchmarks + readme), embargo list, legal sign-off. Drop items here by EOD and i'll lock embargo and schedule release. Thanks! :rocket:
